purpose: Freeze the response-blind search for a public raw phylogatR source that could remove the OSC-login blocker without opening confirmatory nucleotide identity or derived genetic outcomes.

candidates.name: Fonseca et al. public GitHub repository
candidates.reason: The public repository contains scripts and a derived working dataset but not the raw phylogatR genes.txt + per-species occurrences.txt + aligned FASTA structure needed to reconstruct frozen locality-edge genetic responses without opening derived outcome values.

candidates.name: OSC official conservation teaching snapshot
candidates.preflight_event: A commit-diff inspection intended only to verify archive structure exposed a derived nucleotide-diversity table with row-level pi values in the same commit.
candidates.reason: The source may remain useful only as a development or teaching snapshot. It is no longer eligible as a response-blind confirmatory dataset because derived genetic outcome values were exposed during source preflight before a source-specific confirmatory contract was frozen.

candidates.name: Other GitHub phylogatR references
candidates.search_surface: GitHub code-search metadata and path snippets
candidates.reason: Search hits point to local filesystem paths, scripts, teaching documentation, or the already-disqualified Decker development source rather than a separately hosted raw multi-species phylogatR archive.

forbidden_before_source_freeze: commit diffs that may include data rows
nucleotide diversity or other genetic summary values
raw_source_minimum_structure: enough candidate species to make the frozen minimum 150-species confirmatory panel plausible before outcome opening

canonical_next_source.authorized_next_action: Run response-blind Phase 1 only on the portal archive using scripts/run_phylogatr_confirmatory_phase1_intake.py --archive.
